name: BaseLevel.weightedSum_ext
summary: Test on a form y of an eigensystem x. The functions on ℤ/ℓ^ν have the additive characters as a basis; the map T(φ) = Σ_g (φ(c'(g) − k) − iφ(c'(g)))ρ(g)y sends ψ to an eigenvector of character ψ⁻¹∘c'. T(ψ) = (ψ⁻¹(k) − i)·Σ_g ψ(c'(g))ρ(g)y vanishes whenever ψ⁻¹(k) = i, and may vanish also when ψ⁻¹(k) ≠ i (for instance when y has no component in that character space); where T(ψ) = 0 the identity at ψ is trivial, and where T(ψ) ≠ 0 one has ψ⁻¹(k) ≠ i, so h gives the identity on that basis vector. Finally T(f) = weightedSum(ρ, c')(g)(y) by e.

steps.claim: Operators in integralEnd(D, w_Q) are equal when their underlying endomorphisms are; by formEnd_ext it suffices that both sides agree on every form y of level w_Q lying in the isotypic space of an eigensystem x (hy).
steps.lean:
Subtype.ext (formEnd_ext fun x y hy ↦ by
  let T := ∑ g, (.proj ((c g).toAdd - k) - i • .proj (c g).toAdd : (_ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).smulRight
    ((ρ g).1 y); ext1
  simpa [T, hb, weightedSum, e, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, heckeAction, systemAction,
    diagOp_apply _ x hy, ← SetLike.mk_smul_mk, LinearMap.restrict_apply]
    using congr($(((AddChar.complexBasis _).ext fun ψ ↦ dite _ _root_.id fun o ↦ h x ψ⁻¹ _
    (by choose a q using hρ; simp [T, q, sum_mem, smul_mem, Isotypic.map_mem (a _).2 hy]) (fun
    g ↦ by simpa [T, Finset.smul_sum] using sum_equiv (.mulLeft g) _ _ (by simp [← ψ.map_add_eq_mul,
    smul_smul, mul_left_comm, mul_sub, add_sub])) (o ∘ by simp +contextual) (o <| by simp [← ·, T,
    sub_eq_neg_add, ψ.map_add_eq_mul]) : ιℓ.symm _ • (formsOfLevel _).subtype ∘ₗ T =
    ιℓ.symm _ • B ∘ₗ T)) f))

steps.claim: Let T be the ℂ-linear map from functions φ : ℤ/ℓ^ν → ℂ to forms of level w_Q, T(φ) = Σ_{g'∈Γ} (φ(c'(g') − k) − i·φ(c'(g')))·ρ(g')(y); the goal is an equality of forms.
steps.lean:
let T := ∑ g, (.proj ((c g).toAdd - k) - i • .proj (c g).toAdd : (_ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).smulRight
    ((ρ g).1 y); ext1

steps.claim: Both sides at y follow from the identity of linear maps ι_ℓ⁻¹(r(x))·T = ι_ℓ⁻¹(s(x))·(B ∘ T) evaluated at f: by e, T(f) = Σ_{g'} g(c'(g'))ρ(g')y = weightedSum(ρ, c')(g)(y), by hb B of it is b(y), and heckeAction(r), heckeAction(s) act on forms of x by ι_ℓ⁻¹(r(x)), ι_ℓ⁻¹(s(x)) (diagOp_apply). Two linear maps on the functions on ℤ/ℓ^ν agree if they agree on the additive characters, which form a basis; at a character ψ, either the identity holds, or it fails (o) and h is applied to x, ψ⁻¹ and z = T(ψ), whose hypotheses are:
steps.lean:
simpa [T, hb, weightedSum, e, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, heckeAction, systemAction,
    diagOp_apply _ x hy, ← SetLike.mk_smul_mk, LinearMap.restrict_apply]
    using congr($(((AddChar.complexBasis _).ext fun ψ ↦ dite _ _root_.id fun o ↦ h x ψ⁻¹ _
    (by choose a q using hρ; simp [T, q, sum_mem, smul_mem, Isotypic.map_mem (a _).2 hy]) (fun
    g ↦ by simpa [T, Finset.smul_sum] using sum_equiv (.mulLeft g) _ _ (by simp [← ψ.map_add_eq_mul,
    smul_smul, mul_left_comm, mul_sub, add_sub])) (o ∘ by simp +contextual) (o <| by simp [← ·, T,
    sub_eq_neg_add, ψ.map_add_eq_mul]) : ιℓ.symm _ • (formsOfLevel _).subtype ∘ₗ T =
    ιℓ.symm _ • B ∘ₗ T)) f))

steps.claim: T(ψ) lies in the isotypic space of x: each ρ(g') is in localOps(D, Q, j), the restriction of an element of the local group algebra at w_j, which preserves isotypic spaces.
steps.lean: (by choose a q using hρ; simp [T, q, sum_mem, smul_mem, Isotypic.map_mem (a _).2 hy])

steps.claim: T(ψ) is an eigenvector: ρ(g)T(ψ) = ψ⁻¹(c'(g))·T(ψ) for every g, by the substitution g' ↦ g g' in the sum and multiplicativity of ψ.
steps.lean:
(fun
    g ↦ by simpa [T, Finset.smul_sum] using sum_equiv (.mulLeft g) _ _ (by simp [← ψ.map_add_eq_mul,
    smul_smul, mul_left_comm, mul_sub, add_sub]))

steps.claim: T(ψ) ≠ 0: if T(ψ) = 0 both sides of the identity at ψ vanish, contradicting o.
ψ⁻¹(k) ≠ i: otherwise T(ψ) = (ψ(−k) − i)·Σ_{g'} ψ(c'(g'))ρ(g')y = 0 and the identity at ψ holds, contradicting o.
Hence the identity of linear maps ι_ℓ⁻¹(r(x))·(T as a map to forms) = ι_ℓ⁻¹(s(x))·(B ∘ T) holds on the basis, so everywhere; it is applied to f.
steps.lean:
: ιℓ.symm _ • (formsOfLevel _).subtype ∘ₗ T =
    ιℓ.symm _ • B ∘ₗ T)) f))
